name: Horizon Focus

passives.name: Hypershot
passives.effects: Dealing ability damage to a champion with a champion ability at 600 or more units away from the cast position marks them for 6 seconds, revealing them and increasing your damage dealt to them by 10%.

passives.name: Focus
passives.effects: Upon triggering Hypershot, grant sight of the area 1400 units around the target for 2 seconds and apply Hypershot's mark to enemy champions within the area for 3 seconds.
